readings.Aries: There's someone around you who has been trying to get a word in. Let them. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Taurus: Your loyalty is not the issue. The question is whether it's being returned in kind. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Gemini: The decision you can't make is not about the options. It's about what committing would mean. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Cancer: Your intuition about what someone else is feeling is usually right. Your interpretation of why may not be. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Leo: The stage you've been avoiding is smaller than you imagine, and the audience is ready. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Virgo: Something you noticed and catalogued weeks ago is relevant now. Your records are good. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Libra: You manage the emotional temperature of every room you're in. Take a break from that responsibility. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Scorpio: Your instinct for what people really mean is almost always correct. It's protecting you today. Let this one be easy.
readings.Sagittarius: You are searching for a feeling you had once. It is not behind you. It is ahead, in a different form. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Capricorn: You've been holding the line. Today someone else can hold it while you rest. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Aquarius: You care about humanity in aggregate and sometimes miss the individual in front of you. Look closer. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Pisces: Your gift for reading what people need has been extended to everyone except yourself. Read yourself. What worked before will not work the same way this time.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
